item.title: Seido Koukan Shidou ~Toaru Gakuenchou no Yokubougeki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Amenonuboko Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2010-02-19
  • スコア: 5.5/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 性奴交換指導～とある学園長の欲望劇～
  • 英語名: Seido Koukan Shidou Toaru Gakuenchou no Yokubougeki

あらすじ

Noriyuki is the principal of a famous school. One day, he accidentally sees Kaori and Kumiko having sex…. Several days later, he calls Kaori to the principal’s room. “Anything is wrong these days?” Kaori and Kumiko’s sex scene appears on the monitor…. “You’ll have to leave the school and Kumiko’ll have to quit….” Kaori says, “I don’t care about myself, but don’t fire Kumiko!” “Ok, show me your sincerity…. Understand that…?”

  • スコア: 5.7700000000000005/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 美人妻の痴態～兄の妻は俺の嫁～
  • 英語名: Bijin Tsuma no Chitai Ani no Tsuma wa Ore no Yome

あらすじ

Yuki is a caretaker of an apartment. He likes wiretapping, peeping and live chatting. One day, he is surprised to see her face when he enjoys a live chat because the girl he is chatting is Miyako, his older sister-in-law. “Who are you?!”

Yuki soon finishes live chat… A while later, a doorbell of his room rings. When he opens the door, Miyako is standing outside…

item.title: Magical Change Yuuki-kun
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Amenonuboko Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2007-12-14
  • スコア: 5.37/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マジカルチェンジゆうきくん
  • 英語名: Magical Change Yuuki-kun

あらすじ

Yuki looks girlish. He is also sensitive and delicate, so he is treated as a girl at school. One day, when he is outside, something hard strikes him and he loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself lying in a sick-room…. He has become a girl! A doll-like girl suddenly appears in front of him. It seems he’ll need to follow her orders to get back to a boy….
